'''Arts and culture'''
*[[President of Venezuela|Venezuelan president]] [[Nicolás Maduro]] announces that [[Venezuela]] will celebrate an early [[Christmas]] on 1 October. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/christmas-october-venezuela-maduro-moves-holiday-disputed-election-rcna169493 (NBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Mediterranean Sea migrant smuggling]]
**Seven people are rescued and at least 21 others remain missing after a boat carrying [[Syria]]n migrants from [[Libya]] capsizes off the coast of [[Lampedusa]] in the [[Pelagie Islands]] of [[Italy]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/4/at-least-21-people-missing-after-boat-capsizes-off-italian-island (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2024 Brazil wildfires]]
**Twenty percent of the [[Brasília]] [[National forest (Brazil)|National Forest]] in [[Brazil]] is destroyed by a [[wildfire]] that investigators suspect was [[arson|started deliberately]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/wildfire-destroys-20-brasilia-forest-arson-suspected-2024-09-04/ (Reuters)] 

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Apalachee High School shooting]]
**Four people are killed and nine people are wounded in a [[Mass shooting|mass]] [[school shooting]] at [[Apalachee High School]] in [[Winder, Georgia|Winder]], [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]], [[United States]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/09/04/us/winder-ga-shooting-apalachee-high-school/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Brazilian investigation into Elon Musk]]
**[[SpaceX]] removes its employees from [[Brazil]] amid ongoing legal issues between [[CEO]] [[Elon Musk]] and the [[Supreme Federal Court|Brazilian Supreme Court]] over Musk's [[social media]] company [[Twitter|X]]. [https://www.wsj.com/business/telecom/spacex-brazil-elon-musk-supreme-court-2acb87e3?reflink=mobilewebshare_permalink (''The Wall Street Journal'')]
*[[Grenfell Tower fire]]
**The [[Grenfell Tower Inquiry Phase 2|second phase]] of the [[Grenfell Tower Inquiry]] concludes, with the report noting "systematic dishonesty" of manufacturers and the failures of the [[Government of the United Kingdom|government]] leading up to the fire. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cgedv58e7ygo (BBC News)]
*''[[Hachette v. Internet Archive]]''
**The [[Internet Archive]] loses its court appeal in a [[Copyright infringement|copyright lawsuit]] over its [[Digital library|digital library]] of [[Ebook|ebooks]] and documents that major [[Publishing|publication companies]] have worked to shut down over claims of lost revenue. [https://www.jurist.org/news/2024/09/us-federal-appeals-court-confirms-internet-archive-infringes-us-publisher-copyright-protections/ (Jurist)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/09/04/technology/internet-archive-appeals-court-ruling.html (''The New York Times'')]
*Dismissed mayor of [[Bamban]], [[Philippines]], [[Alice Guo]] is arrested by the [[Directorate General of Immigration]] in [[Tangerang]], [[Indonesia]], after fleeing from the Philippines amid an ongoing [[Senate of the Philippines|Senate]] inquiry. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/article/2024/sep/04/alice-guo-philippine-fugitive-mayor-arrest-indonesia-alleged-china-ties-ntwnfb (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.rappler.com/philippines/alice-guo-arrested-jakarta-indonesia/ (Rappler)]
*[[Jonathan Meijer]] files a lawsuit against [[Netflix]] for allegedly [[defamation|portraying him negatively]] for his serial [[sperm donation]] in its [[documentary]] series ''[[The Man with 1,000 Kids]]''. [https://www.dw.com/en/dutch-serial-sperm-donor-sues-sensationalist-netflix/a-70134557 (DW)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Election of the VIII Māori monarch]]
**The [[New Zealand]] [[New Zealand Māori Council|Māori Council]] selects [[Ngā Wai Hono i te Pō]] as the new [[Māori King movement|Queen]] following the death of her father King [[Tūheitia]] in August. [https://www.dw.com/en/new-zealands-maori-crown-new-queen/a-70137204 (DW)]
*[[Government of Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Ukraine)|foreign affairs minister]] [[Dmytro Kuleba]] [[resign]]s from office amid a [[cabinet reshuffle]]. [https://lb.ua/news/2024/09/04/632933_ministr_zakordonnih_sprav_dmitro.html (Left Bank)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/09/04/ukraine-foreign-minister-resignation-dmytro-kuleba/ (''The Washington Post'')]
*In [[Canada]], [[New Democratic Party]] leader [[Jagmeet Singh]] announces that he has terminated the [[confidence and supply]] agreement his party made with [[Prime Minister of Canada|Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]]'s [[Liberal Party of Canada|Liberal]] government in 2022. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/jagmeet-singh-ndp-ending-agreement-1.7312910 (CBC News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*A small {{convert|1.5|m|ft|adj=on}} [[asteroid]], [[2024 RW1|{{mp|2024 RW|1}}]], is predicted to fall harmlessly as a [[Meteoroid#Fireball|fireball]] over the island of [[Luzon]] in the Philippines at approximately 16:40 [[UTC]] (00:40 [[Philippine Standard Time|local time]]), the [[asteroid impact prediction#List of successfully predicted asteroid impacts|ninth]] asteroid to be successfully discovered before impacting Earth.
